artworks.title: Robert Carr, Earl of Somerset and His Countess
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals posing side by side. The man on the left wears a hat with a large feather, a doublet, a short cape, stockings, and bow-adorned shoes. The woman on the right wears a gown with puffed sleeves and a lace collar, with a bejeweled headpiece in her voluminous hair. Both individuals are in front of a checkered floor, with a coat of arms featuring a crown in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Thomas Howard, First Earl of Suffolk
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He wears a large, dark hat and formal attire with an ornate ruff around his neck, a patterned cloak, and a chain or decorative clasp. The portrait's framework includes flowing banners with Latin inscriptions and two cherubs holding scepters and a coat of arms at the top. The background features intricate patterns and engravings.

artworks.title: Thomas Howard, First Earl of Suffolk
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a dark band, a ruffled collar framing his face. The man has a mustache and a beard, styled hair under the hat, and is holding a baton of office. He is dressed in elaborate attire with decorative patterns, a thick coat, and ornate cuffs. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate frame with scrollwork and inscribed text, and two cherubs at the top corners. The background features intricate engravings and a crest above the man's head.

artworks.title: Thomas Sutton, Founder of the Charterhouse
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, looking directly at the viewer. He has a mature face with distinct features such as a high forehead, arched eyebrows, long beard, and mustache. His hair is neatly combed back. He wears an ornate outfit with a fur-trimmed coat, detailed high-collared doublet, ruffled collar, and an elaborate chain around his neck. He has a ring on his left hand and holds a scroll or document. The background features a decorative frame with floral and scroll motifs, along with inscriptions and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Sir Richard Whittington
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a man identified as Richard Whitington. His head is turned slightly to the left, with a stoic expression. He has prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and thin lips. He wears a fabric headgear, an ornate garment with a high collar, a fur-trimmed robe, and an intricate chain with a medallion around his neck. He is holding a cat in his left arm. The black and white background features an elaborate architectural border with decorative elements, including scrolls and shields, and an inscription around the portrait. Above and below the portrait are additional inscribed panels.

artworks.title: Sir Richard Whittington
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, positioned facing forward with a slight turn to his right. His facial features include a long, narrow face with a pointed nose and high cheekbones. He is wearing a head covering with a slight drapery effect, which partially covers his hair. The man is dressed in elaborate clothing, consisting of a robe adorned with a detailed and ornate collar and a heavy, decorative chain around his shoulders, from which hangs a large, intricate pendant. In his left hand, he holds a cat, which sits calmly, while his right hand is resting below the cat. The background features a circular decorative border inscribed with text and is accompanied by heraldic symbols and an ornate design featuring a cherubic figure at the top. Below the portrait is an inscribed panel detailing achievements attributed to Richard Whittington.

artworks.title: Thomas Wolsey, Cardinal Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual from the waist up, positioned in profile facing left. He has distinct facial features, wearing a cap with a circular emblem on the side, and ornate robes. He is holding a cylindrical object in his left hand. In the background is a coat of arms with two lion-like figures and a shield, accompanied by text identifying him as "Thomas Wolsey." The background features horizontal lines, and below the portrait is a block of stylized text in Latin.

artworks.title: Thomas Wolsey, Cardinal
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up, positioned in profile facing to the right. He has distinct facial features with a prominent nose, a slightly recessed chin, and tightly closed lips. His hair is covered by a hat with a wide band and a ring-shaped ornament on the side. He wears a robe with elaborate patterns over his shoulders and holds a scroll in his hand. The background is plain with horizontal lines creating a shaded effect. An inscription below the portrait identifies the person as "THOMAS WOLSEY CARDINALL, ARCHBISHOP OF YORK & CHAUNCELLOR OF ENGLAND: Died Nov. 29: 1529."

artworks.title: Thomas Wolsey, Cardinal
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in profile facing right. He is dressed in clerical robes with intricate detailing. His features include a prominent nose and a high forehead. He wears a cap with a circular design, and a cape over his shoulders. The man holds an object in his right hand which rests across his body. The background is plain with horizontal lines. The engraving identifies him as "Thomas Wolsey Cardinall Archbishop of York & Chauncelor of England: Died Nov: 29: 1529."

artworks.title: Title Page, De Republica Ecclesiatica by MarcAntonio de Dominis
artworks.description: This is a cover page for a book titled "De Republica Ecclesiastica" by Marco Antonio de Dominis. The central area features the text of the book's title and author, surrounded by decorative elements. At the top, a female figure is enthroned with a lion to her left and a multi-headed dragon to her right, each accompanied by scrolls with Latin inscriptions. She holds keys and a cross. Below the central text, two figures stand on either side holding a staff or crook. Smaller circular scenes of pastoral landscapes are below them. The composition includes detailed architectural elements, decorative motifs, cherubic faces, and scrolls. The style resembles detailed Renaissance engravings with religious and allegorical themes.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth in Parliament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal assembly in a grand hall. The image shows an interior with a checkerboard floor, a decorated ceiling with wooden beams, an elevated throne draped with fabric and adorned with a crest. Surrounding the throne are tiered seating sections with figures in robes and headwear. The figures are arranged in an orderly manner. The walls have intricate designs, possibly tapestries or woodwork.

artworks.title: James I Enthroned
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a throne. They have refined facial features, wear a crown and ornate robes, and hold a scepter. The throne and surroundings are elaborately decorated, including draped curtains, a canopy with symbols, a tiled floor, and a grand carpet.

artworks.title: James I in Parliament
artworks.description: The image shows an interior scene with a large assembly of individuals in a grand hall. People are seated or standing in rows, dressed in robes and capes, some wearing historical formal hats. The individuals face away or sideways from the viewer. The hall has a central aisle with seated individuals on two sides facing each other. A chair resembling a throne, under a canopy, is located further into the room, where a person is seated. The floor is checkered, and large windows line the walls. The background is richly decorated, implying formality or ceremony.

artworks.title: Title Page. James I, an Opera
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The facade includes two figural sculptures within niches. The left niche shows an angelic figure holding a book and the right niche features an armored figure. At the top, two winged figures herald an inscription below a crowned emblem. The central panel, flanked by columns and ornamentation, bears a Latin script dedicated to a figure named Jacobus. The base of the structure has inscriptions related to publication information dated 1616. The drawing features detailed line work typical of engravings, creating a tapestry of textures and symbolic elements.

artworks.title: Title Page. English Catechisme by John Mayer
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural structure with religious elements. The facade resembles a church or temple and features the text "The English Catechisme by John Mayer, B'. of Divinity. Printed for John Marriott 1621." The structure has columns and ornate detailing, akin to classical architecture. Above the entrance, beams of light emanate from a cloud with Hebrew script. Adjacent to the main structure are two alcoves with symbolic figures. On the left, figures with scrolls are shown, while on the right, a figure stands near a pulpit with a serpent-like form on a lectern. Below the main platform, an engraving states "Christ is the Rock," with figures under an arch. The imagery conveys religious themes through its design and symbols.

artworks.title: Title Page to Sir Walter Raleigh, History of the World
artworks.description: This is an image depicting an allegorical scene with several symbolic figures and a globe. The drawing features a globe with an eye above it labeled "PROVIDENTIA", two angelic figures labeled "FAMA BONA" and "FAMA MALA", a central figure labeled "MAGISTRA VITAE", and skeletal figures labeled "MORS" and "OBLIVIO". There are niches on the sides with figures representing "TESTIS TEMPORUM" and "VITA MEMORIAE". The artwork includes various symbols and inscriptions. A printed note indicates it was created in London in 1652, placing it within a specific historical context. The style is emblematic, with allegorical and Renaissance symbolism.

artworks.title: Title Page. Jean de Serres, Generall Historie of France
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a book title page. It features intricate engravings with a central block of text that states "Generall Historie of France," along with details such as the author "John de Serres," the publisher "George Eld," and a publication date of 1611. The artwork includes two figures holding objects on either side of the title text. At the top, there is a coat of arms displayed with figures holding a sickle and scales. At the bottom, there is a framed portrait of a man with a laurel wreath. The composition includes architectural elements and heraldic imagery.

artworks.title: Domini Robert Episcopi Salisbury (Robert Abbot, Bishop of Salisbury)
artworks.description: The image shows a historical portrait of a man with an elongated face and a long beard. He wears a cap, a traditional ruff, and a detailed garment with puffed sleeves. He holds an open book and is surrounded by ornamental scrollwork with inscriptions in Latin. The composition is framed within an oval.

artworks.title: Catherine Mannes
artworks.description: The image features a young woman standing in an angled position, holding a fan. The woman has a rounded face, arched eyebrows, and curly hair styled away from her face. She wears an ornate dress with lace details, embroidered patterns, and puffy sleeves, along with a necklace with a cross pendant. The background includes an oval frame with scrollwork and a coat of arms, with text circling the frame and in a plaque at the bottom.

artworks.title: Willmus Burton de Falde (William Burton de Falde)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man with a receding hairline and short hair. He is holding a rolled document with his hands in front of him. The man has a broad forehead, pronounced brows, a neatly trimmed beard, and a mustache. He is dressed in an outfit with detailed embroidery, a lace ruff around his neck, and lace cuffs on his sleeves. An inkwell with a quill sits on a table to the right. The border of the oval portrait features heraldic elements, including a dragon rampant on a helmet in the left corner and two crowned lions' heads in a shield on the right. The background of the portrait is intricately engraved.

artworks.title: Charles I, as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is an engraving portrait depicting a person from the upper body up. The individual faces forward in a three-quarter position with a formal appearance. The person has a youthful face with prominent eyes, smooth skin, and hair styled back. They wear elaborate clothing with a high lace collar, a doublet, and a fur-accented cloak. A medallion or brooch is on the chest area. The background has scrolling decoration, an inscription, emblems, and book motifs on both sides of the person. The portrait includes a poetic inscription at the bottom and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Charles I, as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a figure from the waist up, seated in a formal and frontal pose. The individual has soft facial features with an oval face, straight nose, and prominent eyes. His hair is styled with curls, slightly parted in the middle. He is dressed in a historical attire with a lace collar and ornate fabric. He wears a circular medallion around his neck on a ribbon and holds decorative gloves near his waist with his right hand. The background features an oval frame with swirling patterns and inscriptions surrounding the figure. Textual elements and symbols, including a coat of arms, are visible on the outer edges of the frame and plain background outside the frame.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person seated facing the viewer. The individual has an upright posture, with the head slightly turned to the left. The person has a high forehead, thin arched eyebrows, and full lips. The hair is styled in curls and adorned with a feather or ornament. The attire consists of a detailed gown with voluminous sleeves, a high lace collar, and embellishments like embroidery, pearls, and gemstones. Accessories include a necklace, pendants, a brooch, and gloves. The background features a celestial design with stars forming a halo around the head, and an emblem with a coat of arms, a lion, and a unicorn.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in an ornate position, looking directly at the viewer. She has high cheekbones, a straight nose, and thin lips. Her hair is styled in tight curls with a star-studded headdress. She wears an intricately embellished gown with a pleated ruff, puffed sleeves, and detailed lace. She holds a fan or plush object in her lap and other items in her hands. She wears jewelry and the background features swirling clouds or feathers and a coat of arms.
